ledger.claim: The GPS trace measures this trip at 15.06 km against a booked optimal of 11.8 km, an excess of 3.26 km or 27.63% — so both limbs of the POL-RD-01 gate are satisfied: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and it exceeds 0.8 km in absolute terms. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measure and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km (a rounded 15.1 km convenience copy) for the threshold test; the trace figure clears the gate on its own.

The excess is not merely pleaded, it is established on this trip's own trace, and the trace is clean for policy purposes: 119 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. None of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) impairments is present, so the deviation may be established on the GPS trace alone and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is needed.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and has discharged it: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier TRP-02854, the trace's first fix (2026-09-09T11:59:18+08:00) matches the recorded trip start, and the excess of 3.26 km / 27.63% clears the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause; a general assertion that traffic was bad, cited to nothing, does not discharge it.

The driver's explanation — 'there was a massive jam on the expressway' — is supported by no artifact. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory covering this trip: EV-ADVIS-02854-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, no payload), and the driver cites no advisory evidence ID. Note the disclosure: that artifact is relied on only for its absence, which POL-RD-01's scheme and the general rules make citable, not for any content. POL-RD-03 is unavailable — it requires an advisory record naming a road the optimal route traverses, with a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle reaching that segment — and under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 the driver's assertion carries no weight, reduces no excess and supplies no amended optimal route.

No exculpatory clause is available on the facts of this trip. The chat log for TRP-02854 is empty (0 messages), so there is no rider instruction that could trigger POL-RD-04; neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has no amendment to re-quote against; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply. The booked optimum of 11.8 km therefore stands as the baseline.

The enhanced corroboration requirement in POL-RD-08 is not triggered. It applies only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer; this rider's figures are 0 and 0. Both are citable for this test, and only for this test, under POL-GEN-01. The trace evidence therefore suffices without more.

The refund is the arithmetic of POL-RD-02, not a discretion. This is a METERED fare, so the clause runs: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 11.8 + 0.28 × 15.9) × the surge_multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown (1.0) + 0.80 platform fee = 17.9020. Refund = charged_total 21.45 − 17.9020 = 3.5480, which rounds UP to SGD 3.55. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below the 90%-of-charged full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of $3.55. charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund are three separate lines.

The fare record shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00: the disputed charge is still with the platform. Because this dispute is rider-filed, a PARTIAL_REFUND actually moves $3.55 back to the rider, whereas NO_ACTION would leave the charge exactly where it is. The rider's win here is a refund; the status quo is not a rider win.

Nothing in this record compels escalation over a decidable monetary claim. POL-RD-10(3) cannot fire because the trace is unimpaired; POL-RD-10(2) cannot fire because the identifiers match; POL-RD-10(6) cannot fire because the refund of $3.55 exceeds neither $150 nor charged_total. On POL-RD-10(5): the driver cited no advisory evidence ID at all, and where the asserting party names no advisory, POL-RD-13(1) provides that the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so the trigger is not engaged and the money moves. (EV-ADVIS-02854-01 is MISSING, code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0; it is cited here only for its absence.)

The trace figure governs, and on the trace the excess is 3.26 km, or 27.6% of the 11.8 km optimal route (POL-RD-01 directs that gps_trace.trace_distance_km 15.06 km be used, not the rounded 15.1 km convenience copy on the trip record). That clears the establishment gate, but it sits well below BOTH materiality gates - an excess above 50% of optimal, or above 8.0 km absolute. This is therefore an ordinary established deviation and not a MATERIAL one, so POL-RD-06's material-deviation consequences, the FULL_REFUND uplift in limb (b) and the driver-conduct referral in limb (c), do not run against this driver.

Even if POL-RD-06's driver-profile check were reached, no pattern is established on the only two fields that clause permits to be used: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the threshold of 3, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 387 is 0.0026, far below the 0.05 ratio (387 also exceeds the 40-trip minimum). The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags also reads 1, but POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting that near-synonym for the trailing-90-day field the clause names. No remedy uplift and no conduct referral can follow from this profile.

ledger.claim: If the case is decided on the merits, the ceiling on any rider recovery is fixed by POL-RD-02's arithmetic and is small: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 11.8 + 0.28 x 15.9) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 17.902, so the refund is charged_total 21.45 less 17.902 = 3.548, rounded up to SGD 3.55. That is below the 4.50 contested, is only 16.5% of charged_total so the 90% FULL_REFUND threshold is nowhere near, and it exceeds the 0.50 de minimis floor - so nothing larger than a 3.55 partial can issue. The surge multiplier of 1.0 was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, not from the trip record.

The driver's explanation is an external traffic cause - a jam with traffic diverting. The only artifact that can test that explanation is the trip's traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02854-01, and that artifact is MISSING: its admissibility status is MISSING, its weight_multiplier is 0.0, its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT, and it carries no payload, so it can support no fact about this trip. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against that advisory and nothing else, and POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record. Because the driver points to the bundle's advisory artifact - the very artifact POL-RD-03 requires - and not to a free-floating assertion, this is an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact missing from the pool within POL-RD-10(5), a reading POL-RD-13 expressly preserves where the party cites the missing identifier. The disputed amount should therefore be held for a human reviewer rather than a monetary ruling issued on the platform's own evidentiary gap.

ruling.explanation:
This is a route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02854, filed by the rider.

DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing measure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 15.06 km (EV-GPS-02854); the trip record's 15.1 km is a rounded convenience copy and may not be used for the threshold test. Against the booked optimal of 11.8 km (EV-TRIP-02854) the excess is 3.26 km, or 27.63% — above both establishment gates (20% of optimal and 0.8 km absolute), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL: 3.26 km is below 8.0 km and 27.63% is below 50%, so POL-RD-06's uplift and conduct referral do not run against this driver.

TRACE INTEGRITY (POL-RD-07). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 119 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. None of limbs (a)–(c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver says there was a massive jam and everyone was diverting. POL-RD-13 tests an external-cause assertion against the trip's traffic_advisory and nothing else, and the driver named no advisory evidence ID. EV-ADVIS-02854-01 is MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload — and it is relied on only for its absence (POL-GEN-02(3)). Under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5): the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable. Under POL-RD-08 the driver's uncited assertion carries no weight, reduces no excess and supplies no amended optimal route. The driver advocate's plea for a POL-RD-10(5) escalation on this ground is rejected for that reason.

NO OTHER EXCULPATORY ROUTE. The chat log has 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 has no instruction; no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-quote; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The 11.8 km optimal stands as the baseline.

REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, METERED). recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 11.8 + 0.28 × 15.9) × the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier + 0.80 platform fee = 17.902. Refund = charged_total 21.45 − 17.902 = 3.548, rounded UP to SGD 3.55. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of $3.55, not a full refund. No off-route ERP or surcharge correction arises: the ERP line set is empty.

NO ESCALATION. POL-RD-10 is not engaged: the trace is unimpaired (3), the trip identifiers on trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all match TRP-02854 (2), no timestamps conflict (4), POL-RD-10(5) fails for the reason given above, the refund exceeds neither $150 nor charged_total (6), the driver's uncited assertion is not comparable-strength contradictory evidence (7), and no unmatched charge line exists (8). No referral arises either: POL-RD-06(c) needs both a material deviation and an established pattern (deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 387 — no pattern), and POL-RD-09(4) has no billing-integrity defect to record.

EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect of $3.55 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04. Confidence is 0.95; the deciding facts — the excess distance and the fare arithmetic — are carried by weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-02854, EV-TRIP-02854, EV-FARE-02854), so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
